pages.text: In order to obtain The Cryptic Eye, you must defeat Ignis, one of the most challenging bosses. Ignis has powerful strikes, as well as ranged shockwave attacks with his sword.
The journey to defeating Ignis leads you through the Burning Arena. It’s an immense, open-floor coliseum with spiral staircases.
Can be obtained by defeating Ignited Revenant at the bottom level. On the upper level of the arena, is the Altar of Fire. Place a Burning Ashes inside, and it will summon Ignis.
